text: なぜか　かてないんだ

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending means 'can do', and with ない it means 'cannot'. かてない = 'can't win'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ, which adds a feeling of explaining how things are. かてないんだ = 'the thing is, I can't win'.
